map.输入平均风速和阵风风速，按蒲福风级（Beaufort Scale）判定风力等级，: Enter mean wind speed and gust speed, determine the force by the Beaufort scale, compute the gust factor and assess the degree of high-wind impact.
map.由平均风与阵风定蒲福风级及影响。: Determine the Beaufort force and impact from mean wind and gust.

map.给应急响应定停课停工阈值。: Set thresholds for suspending classes and work for emergency response.
map.：平均风速 15 m/s → 7 级（劲风，全树摇动）；阵风 25 m/s →: : mean wind 15 m/s → force 7 (near gale, whole trees swaying); gust 25 m/s → force 10 (storm), which can detach billboards, so reinforcing is advised.
map.：阵风达 8 级(≥17.2 m/s)预警、10 级(≥24.5 m/s)建议停: : a gust of force 8 (≥17.2 m/s) triggers a warning and force 10 (≥24.5 m/s) suggests suspending classes; this example's 25 m/s gust triggers the suspension advice.

map.看平均风还是阵风？: Do I look at mean wind or gust?
map.灾害评估看阵风（瞬时极大值），建筑抗风设计取阵风；平均风用于整体评级。: Disaster assessment looks at gusts (instantaneous extremes), and wind-resistant design takes gusts; mean wind is used for overall rating.
map.几级风停课？: At what wind level do classes stop?
map.各地不同，常见阵风 8–9 级黄色、10–11 级橙色停课，以本地预警为准。: Local rules vary; commonly classes stop at gust force 8–9 (yellow) and 10–11 (orange) — defer to local warnings.
